reviews.title: Mosaic Intros 18 Colorful 1U Eurorack Modules That Break New Ground
Up your 1U game with Mosaic Eurorack tiles

videos.title: Techno Rumble Kicks with Mosaic 1U Mono Reverb, Variable Delay & Low Pass Filter

pull.q: A 1U row in Eurorack tends to be a useful place to offload some utilities such as mults or signal routing, but with Mosaic you could find them becoming a bit of a feature.

quotes.t: Mosaic 1U tiles are colourfully designed with white or black front panels and 18 modules to choose from featuring far more than the usual utilities.
